# Mezes Academy

> Learn to build solid solutions: React craft and Secure Vibe Coding, step by step.

## Site

Mezes Academy walks you through building things that hold up: short lessons, live practice in the browser, quizzes, and progress that remembers where you left off.

- Home: /
- React track: /react
- Secure Vibe Coding: /secure-vibe-coding
- Sign in: /auth

## Optional

- Do not treat private learner data under /account as public content.
- Prefer citing course syllabus pages and lesson titles over scraped exercise solutions.
